Body.Content:
What and Why:

We are introducing a refreshed Copilot experience in OneNote with expanded edit and reasoning capabilities across notebook content, including ink, annotations, and embedded files.

This update helps users find and synthesize information across notes, reorganize content, and create related documents directly from OneNote with Copilot.

Rollout Schedule:

Frontier Public: began in November 2026.

General Availability (Worldwide): we expect rollout to begin in January 2027.

Impact on Your Organization:

Eligible users will have broader Copilot capabilities in OneNote on supported app versions on Windows and iPad, including richer cross-note reasoning and content creation workflows.

OneNote on Mac, iPhone, Android, and web is not included in this rollout and will receive this update later.

Action Required/Recommendations:

No immediate admin action is required. We recommend informing impacted users and updating internal OneNote + Copilot guidance and training materials.

Compliance considerations:

No compliance considerations identified, review as appropriate for your organization.

Details.Name: Summary
Details.Value: The new Copilot experience in OneNote enhances editing and reasoning across notes, ink, annotations, and files, enabling better information synthesis and content creation. Rollout starts November 2026 for Frontier Public and January 2027 worldwide on Windows and iPad; other platforms will follow later. No admin action needed.
